description: Changes one library item by id: status (archived, draft, queued), text (checked against content_rules), or its place in the queue (position first or last, or an explicit order). 409 publishing_in_progress means it is being published; 409 publish_result_unknown means it may already be on Threads; 409 status_changed means it changed since it was read. Applies when the user wants to edit, reorder, archive or restore one item.
name: update_library_item
title: Update a library item
